label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off. The national database record of a past accident inside the area is unverified indirect evidence (E1), but the national criteria make that record a clearance target after the first visit and do not provide technical survey. The visit yielded no evidence that explains or resolves the record; cancellation is not supported.
flags: The database record has no date or further detail, and its location has not been checked on the ground; this recommendation follows the stated national criterion, not a claim that contamination has been confirmed.
Rain prevented the survey team from seeing the land inside the area.
The bus driver did not know the land inside the area and provides no evidence about it.
The zone-survey flag and rank 1 survey priority are not evidence and were not used as such.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1.

E1.quote: The national mine action database records one or more past landmine accidents inside this area.
E1.note: The database's location and reliability have not been checked on the ground, so this is indirect evidence from an unassessed historical record.

E2.quote: The survey team could reach only the edge of the area, because rain had closed the trail into it, and could not see the land inside.
E2.note: This records limited access and no observation of the land inside; it neither indicates EO nor supports absence there.

E3.quote: A bus driver said he only passes along the road at the edge of the area and does not know the land inside it.
E3.note: The informant explicitly does not know the area, so this provides neither evidence of EO nor evidence of absence.
